cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: When handling absolute paths, the method checks if the file is within the directory using isFileWithinDirectory(), but this check can be bypassed when the absolute path shares a prefix with the load path but points to a different directory (e.g., '/Users/foo/resources-alt' vs '/Users/foo/resources')

The method uses startsWith() to check if the canonical path of the file starts with the canonical path of the directory. This allows path traversal when the absolute path shares a common prefix with the load path but points to a different directory (e.g., '/Users/foo/resources-alt/test.png' starts with '/Users/foo/resources')

The load method processes absolute paths through loadFromLoadPath() which eventually calls isFileWithinDirectory() with the vulnerable path validation logic, allowing partial path traversal when absolute paths share a prefix with load paths
